name: advanced-memory-mcp
description: Advanced Memory MCP - A powerful knowledge management system with portmanteau tools for Cursor IDE compatibility. Consolidates 40+ tools into 8 comprehensive tools with full functionality.

index_all_files.title: Index All File Types
index_all_files.description: Index all files (code, configs, markdown) or only .md files. Recommended: true for code repos, false for pure notes. Maps to ADVANCED_MEMORY_INDEX_ALL_FILES.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Maps to ADVANCED_MEMORY_LOG_LEVEL.

sync_changes.title: Auto-Sync Files
sync_changes.description: Automatically sync file changes in real-time. Disable for manual sync only. Maps to ADVANCED_MEMORY_SYNC_CHANGES.

enable_portmanteau_tools.title: Enable Portmanteau Tools
enable_portmanteau_tools.description: Use consolidated adn_* tools (recommended for Cursor IDE). Disable to use individual tools.

max_tools.title: Maximum Tools to Expose
max_tools.description: Limit number of tools for IDE compatibility. Default 50 works for most IDEs.
